scope: Fixed-scope read-only test-world engine inventory, not seed/reset authorization

security_notes: No engine mutation verbs or shell commands admitted; only exact ls/inspect tuples and full lowercase hexadecimal container IDs
Selected inspection format omits environment and secrets; output contains identity/state and booleans, not foreign label values
B404/B603 narrowly suppressed at subprocess import/call after full command allowlist and shell=False; no global security configuration weakened
Engine failures sanitized; 10-second per-command timeout; metadata parser limits inspect JSON to262144characters
Container ID lists limited to64 per query; union may contain up to128 inspected objects per snapshot
limitations: Two matching projected observations are not an atomic snapshot, continuously monitored ownership, exclusive world lock, or execution authorization
Labels are classification hints, not trusted identity proof
No SQL/offline-character/fixture ownership inspection, provisioning, reset, seeding, or gameplay execution
Parser size cap is not a bound on subprocess capture memory or engine output generation
Live environment lacks test resources: no real existing-container/volume inspect path exercised; present and foreign cases use explicit test fixtures
No whole-repository gate claim while independent population/chat implementations are changing other source files
